name: cite
title: Zolai–English dictionary source
description: Configuration of the cite data: the files that hold the rows, the row markup, and every closed list the markup refers to. The file is the single source for both tooling and readers; Markup.md explains the same rules in prose. Every list below is closed: a value that is not listed is an error.

keyword.name: Zolai (Tedim)
keyword.description: Language of every keyword, of the attributes s, a, b and v, and of the Zolai part of an example.

term.name: English
term.description: Language of the attributes w, d, o, q, of the description and of the English part of an example.

format.description: Physical rules of a data file.

core.name: Core lexicon
core.description: General vocabulary of everyday life and of modern subjects, independent of the Bible text. A sense lives in one data file only: a general sense belongs here, a sense that is specific to the Bible text stays in the draft file.

draft.name: Bible lexicon
draft.description: Vocabulary and names drawn from the Bible text, sorted by keyword; rows of one keyword list its senses in order. A row with q was drafted from verse evidence and is not yet confirmed by a speaker of the language; a confirmed row carries no q.

digit-number.name: Digits
digit-number.description: Numbers written with digits in the Bible text.

noun-kha.name: Months
noun-kha.description: Zolai names of the months (kha). The keyword is the Zolai name; the English month is the term.

noun-ni.name: Days of the week
noun-ni.description: Zolai names of the days of the week (ni). The keyword is the Zolai name; the English day is the term.

noun-testament.name: Testaments
noun-testament.description: Names of the two testaments of the Bible.

noun-book.name: Bible books
noun-book.description: Names of the 66 books of the Bible, in canonical order.

keyword.description: The Zolai headword that starts a row. Case is significant: Pasian and pasian are different keywords. Words are joined by one space, one hyphen or one apostrophe; a final apostrophe is allowed.

=.name: separator
=.description: The first = on a line ends the keyword and starts the body. A line without = is a keyword-only row.

#.name: comment
#.description: A line whose first character is # is a comment. A comment cannot follow a row on the same line.

().name: attribute
().description: Parentheses are reserved for attributes, written (key:value). They never appear in a keyword, inside a value or in the description.

/.name: list separator
/.description: Separates the items of a list attribute. In a text attribute and in the description it is an ordinary character.

~.name: keyword placeholder
~.description: Stands for the keyword in the Zolai part of an example row. Allowed only there.

|.name: translation separator
|.description: In an example row, separates the Zolai example from its English translation. Allowed only there, exactly once per row.

<>.name: cross-reference
<>.description: Encloses a keyword that exists in the data, or the key of one sense, as in khat.2; a tool shows it as a link. Several are written one after another or joined by the list separator, so that <a/b> is the same as <a> and <b>. Allowed in the attributes d and q and in the description.

{}.name: mention
{}.description: Encloses Zolai text inside English prose that is not a link: a phrase, an ending such as -pa, a form without a row, or the keyword of the row itself. A tool shows it as Zolai. A single keyword that has a row is written as a cross-reference instead. Allowed in the attributes d and q and in the description.

..name: sense key
..description: Joins a keyword and a sense number into the key of one sense, as in kipat.2. A sense key starts every row of an example file and of a translation file.

i.name: sense
i.description: Number of this sense of the keyword: a positive whole number, unique among the rows of one keyword in all data files and never reused. Keyword and number form the sense key, as in kipat.2.

t.name: type
t.description: Word class of the keyword. Exactly one code from the type list.

c.name: category
c.description: What kind of thing the keyword names. One or more codes from the category list.

f.name: field
f.description: Subject area in which this sense is used. One or more codes from the field list.

w.name: term
w.description: English word or words with the same meaning as this sense of the keyword. Items of one row are interchangeable; a different meaning goes on its own row.

d.name: definition
d.description: English explanation of the meaning, used when no English term fits or in addition to one. May contain cross-references.

s.name: synonym
s.description: Keywords with the same meaning. Every item is a keyword that exists in the data.

a.name: antonym
a.description: Keywords with the opposite meaning. Every item is a keyword that exists in the data.

b.name: base
b.description: The keyword this form is built from, for plural, suffixed and prefixed forms. One keyword that exists in the data.

j.name: joins
j.description: The keywords that this written form joins or respells. Several items: separate words written as one, as aom joins a and om. One item: the same word in another spelling; such a row may leave out w and d and then carries the meaning of the keyword it names. Every item is a keyword that exists in the data.

v.name: variant
v.description: Other spellings of the same keyword. An item is never the keyword of another row.

o.name: origin
o.description: Language the keyword comes from, optionally followed by a comma and the source word.

r.name: reference
r.description: Where this sense is attested. A Bible verse is written book.chapter.verse with book numbers 1 to 66, and a verse range uses a hyphen. Any other source is written as a code from the source list, optionally followed by a colon and a locator inside that source.

q.name: query
q.description: Open question about the row. Its presence marks the row as not verified.

text.name: description
text.description: Free English text after the last attribute: a remark on usage or grammar that is not the meaning itself. May contain cross-references.

name.name: proper name
name.description: Name of one person, people, place, clan, book or other individual thing. The keyword starts with an uppercase letter.

prep.name: preposition
prep.description: Relation word translated by an English preposition.

part.name: particle
part.description: Particle: a prefix, suffix or sentence-final word with a grammatical function.

ppm.name: postpositional marker
ppm.description: Marker placed after a word to show case, place, time or tense.

num.name: number
num.description: Cardinal or ordinal number, in words or digits.

phrase.name: phrase
phrase.description: Fixed combination of words listed as one keyword.

see.name: redirect
see.description: Row that only points to another keyword. The body is the type followed by exactly one cross-reference.

todo.name: to do
todo.description: Keyword collected but not yet described.

people.name: people
people.description: Name of a nation, tribe or group of people.

land.name: land
land.description: Name of a country, region or territory.

place.name: place
place.description: Name of a place that fits no narrower category.

khua.name: village or town
khua.description: Name of a village or town.

star.name: star
star.description: Name of a star or constellation.

kha.name: month
kha.description: Month of the year. Rows are of type n.

ni.name: day of the week
ni.description: Day of the week. Rows are of type n.

book.name: Bible book
book.description: Name of a book of the Bible.

testament.name: testament
testament.description: Name of a testament of the Bible.

animal.name: animal
animal.description: Animal, bird, fish or other living creature.

everyday.name: everyday
everyday.description: Common words of daily speech: greetings, basic actions, qualities and things.

social.name: social
social.description: Community, relationships, customs, manners and public life.

body.name: body
body.description: The human body and its parts.

home.name: home
home.description: House, furniture, clothing and household things.

it.name: information technology
it.description: Computers, phones, software and the internet.

politics.name: politics
politics.description: Government, law, elections, war and public affairs.

religion.name: religion
religion.description: Church life, belief and worship outside the Bible text.

zai.name: zolai-ai merged dictionary
zai.description: English to Zolai dictionary data of the zolai-ai project, merged there from the dictionaries of Thang Khan Dal, Dal Lian Haokip, Mang Cin Pau Gualnam and the ZomiDictionary application. The locator is the English headword.
zai.owner: Peter Lianpi and the Zolai Project Contributors
zai.credit: Dictionary data from the zolai-ai project, github.com/peterlianpi/zolai-ai

moby.name: Moby Thesaurus
moby.description: Moby Thesaurus by Grady Ward, public domain. Relates an English word to English words of similar meaning. The locator is the English term of a sense through which the linked word was found.

zd.name: Zomi Daily
zd.description: Articles of the news site Zomi Daily, written in Zolai, 2016 to 2026. The locator is the article id of the site.
zd.permission: Requested by the editor in October 2026; the wording of the credit is not yet received. Only single words and short fragments of sentences are quoted.

ts.name: Tongsan
ts.description: Articles of the news site Tongsan, the Zolai articles only, 2025 to 2026. The locator is the article id of the site.
ts.permission: Requested by the editor in October 2026; the wording of the credit is not yet received. Only single words and short fragments of sentences are quoted.

nob.name: Norwegian
nob.description: Terms and definitions in Norwegian Bokmål.

link.description: English words that are not a term of any sense, each linked to the closest senses. A row is the English word in lowercase, the separator and one or more sense keys, the closest first, optionally followed by the attributes r and q. A link does not state that the meanings are equal; it sends a reader to the nearest keyword.

example.description: Examples are kept beside each data file in an example file. A row is a sense key, the separator, the Zolai example with the keyword written as ~, the translation separator and the English translation, optionally followed by the attribute r naming where the example comes from. A sense may have any number of example rows.

index.description: Generated lists for lookup; never edited by hand. The keyword index lists every keyword under a form that ignores case, hyphens, spaces and apostrophes, with its sense keys. The term index lists every English term in lowercase with the sense keys it leads to. The join index lists every keyword named in j with the sense keys of the written forms that join or respell it.

alias.description: Type tags used before version 1 and the attributes that replace them. Used only to convert existing rows; an alias is not valid in a version 1 row.

bible.description: Bible translations read by the tooling. Paths are relative to the repository root. The tooling never writes to these files.

word.description: Word lists generated from the Bible translations, one file per language and model. Each word carries its number of occurrences and the first verse where it occurs.

model.plain: Runs of letters. A hyphen or apostrophe ends a word.
model.dash: Whole written forms that contain a hyphen.
model.apostrophe: Whole written forms that contain or end with an apostrophe. A right single quotation mark directly after a letter counts as an apostrophe.
model.exclamation: Written forms directly followed by an exclamation mark, listed with the mark.
model.question: Written forms directly followed by a question mark, listed with the mark.

rule.name: file
rule.description: A listed file is missing, a data file in the directory is not listed, or a file is not UTF-8, starts with a byte order mark, or contains a tab or carriage return.

rule.name: keyword
rule.description: The keyword is empty or does not match the keyword pattern.

rule.name: empty body
rule.description: Nothing follows the separator.

rule.name: parenthesis
rule.description: A parenthesis is not part of a well-formed attribute: unbalanced, nested, or used in the description.

rule.name: unknown attribute
rule.description: The attribute key is not in the attribute list.

rule.name: repeated attribute
rule.description: The same attribute key occurs more than once in a row.

rule.name: empty value
rule.description: An attribute value or a list item is empty.

rule.name: type
rule.description: The attribute t is missing or its value is not in the type list.

rule.name: category
rule.description: A value of the attribute c is not in the category list.

rule.name: meaning
rule.description: The row has neither w nor d, its type is not see or todo, and it does not name exactly one keyword in j.

rule.name: placeholder
rule.description: The symbol ~ or | is used outside an example row, the Zolai part of an example has no ~, or an example row has more than one |.

rule.name: cross-reference
rule.description: The symbols < and > are unbalanced, used outside d, q and the description, or enclose something that is not a keyword or a sense key.

rule.name: unresolved keyword
rule.description: A keyword named in s, a, b or a cross-reference, or a sense key named in a cross-reference, does not exist in the data.

rule.name: variant
rule.description: A value of the attribute v is not a valid keyword, or is the keyword of a row.

rule.name: reference
rule.description: A value of the attribute r is neither book.chapter.verse nor a code of the source list with an optional locator.

rule.name: duplicate
rule.description: Two rows are identical in keyword, type, category, term and definition, two example rows of one sense have the same Zolai text, or a translation file has two rows for one sense.

rule.name: name case
rule.description: The keyword of a row of type name does not start with an uppercase letter or a digit.

rule.name: redirect
rule.description: A row of type see has anything other than exactly one cross-reference after the type.

rule.name: file scope
rule.description: A described row lacks an attribute value that its file requires.

rule.name: translation
rule.description: An example row has no English translation after the Zolai.

rule.name: sense
rule.description: A row with a meaning lacks the attribute i, the value is not a positive whole number, or two rows of one keyword share a number.

rule.name: field
rule.description: A value of the attribute f is not in the field list.

rule.name: unresolved sense
rule.description: The key of an example row or of a translation row is not the sense key of a row in the data files.

rule.name: link
rule.description: A link row names a word that is already a term of a sense, no sense key, a sense key that is not in the data files, or the same sense key twice.

rule.name: mention
rule.description: Braces are unbalanced, empty, used outside d, q and the description, enclose a cross-reference, or enclose one keyword that has a row of its own.

rule.name: joined form
rule.description: The attribute j names the keyword of the row itself, or the same keyword twice.

rule.name: separator spacing
rule.description: The separator is not written as one space, =, one space.

rule.name: spacing
rule.description: The line has leading or trailing spaces, repeated spaces, spaces inside the parentheses or around a list separator, or a translation separator not written as one space, |, one space.

rule.name: attribute order
rule.description: The attributes are not in the configured order.

rule.name: description position
rule.description: The description is not after the last attribute.

rule.name: final newline
rule.description: The file does not end with exactly one newline.

rule.name: index
rule.description: A generated index file is missing or differs from the data.

rule.name: credits
rule.description: The generated credits file is missing or differs from the source list.

level.error: The row or file is invalid and needs an editor's decision.
level.form: The content is valid but not in canonical form; the repair is mechanical and changes no meaning.
